identity_check: Confirmed as Tandem Intelligence, Inc. (tandem.inc; product login at app.tandemai.io, the tandemai.io domain VCBacked links), an AI-native development platform for hardware teams. tandem.inc/company names co-CEOs Kunal Jain and Arjun Jain and CTO Lokesh Kamanboina, matching Every's founder profile (2026-08-12) and Antler's Spring 2026 U.S. showcase entry (co-CEOs Arjun and Kunal, ex-Rolls-Royce and Boeing). Site footer reads 'SAN FRANCISCO' and '©2026 Tandem Intelligence INC.'; the terms name Tandem Intelligence, Inc. Not the Paris-based in-app AI-agent startup also called Tandem, not Tandem Capital (Bay Area seed fund), not TandemLaunch (Montreal venture studio). Category direct and layer design_intent kept from our notes: the company says it exists to keep 'design intent, requirements, and engineering decisions connected', the same requirements / design-intent tooling Utopian Autonomy builds for hardware teams. Founded year is not published (Every says it launched about eight months before 2026-08-12). Our notes' investor list (Foundation Capital, Also Capital, Antler, Genius Ventures plus angels) matches the company page exactly; only Foundation Capital is tied to a specific round (lead of the seed).
